query: Expense ratio of HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth

hits.text: Expense ratio A fee payable to a mutual fund house for managing your mutual fund investments. It is the total percentage of a company's fund assets used for administrative, management, advertising, and other expenses. Tax

hits.section: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth
hits.text: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by HDFC Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 10 Dec 1999. Amar Kalkundrikar is the Current Fund Manager of HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹9,34,076 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 03 Nov 2026 is ₹1,470.70. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹500. ;
The HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan Growth is rated Very High risk.

Dec 2025 - Present View details Education Mr. Kalkundrikar has done B.Com, CA, CFA, and MBA from Columbia Business School. Experience Prior to joining HDFC Asset Management Company Limited, he has worked with Nippon India Mutual Fund, and HDFC AMC. He worked with multiple roles at HDFC MF. Also manages these schemes
